notes.title: Teatopia Coming to Kickstarter! Follow us to stay updated!
notes.notes:
We are soooo excited (and anxious even!) to announce Teatopia is coming soon to Kickstarter! ːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyː

Stay tuned by following us on Kickstarter to be the first to receive notifications at campaign launch!
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/yixingames/teatopia]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/yixingames/teatopia[/url]

As longtime enthusiasts of farming simulators and management games, our passion for each farming sim runs deep. As dedicated games of this genre, we have been eagerly anticipating the opportunity to create our own farming game.

Our hometown, renowned for its tea production, has a rich history of tea cultivation and trade. Over time, what began as humble villages evolved into energetic markets and eventually towns, with tea farming at the heart of our community's livelihood. Inspired by this integral aspect of our lives, we infused it into our game. Against the background of ancient oriental culture, our leisurely farming game set in the mystical town of Teatopia, where humans and "Yaoguai" coexist, began to take shape.

To create a truly immersive experience, we want to add lots of new content and expand the size of Teatopia. To bring our dream game to life, we recognize the importance of harnessing the power of the community, not only for financial support but more importantly, for your invaluable insights to refine our game. Therefore, after thorough consideration, we have decided to bring Teatopia to Kickstarter, an optimal platform for us to find an engaing community at an early stage. And we are committed to crafting a great game that promises to deliver long-lasting joy, fun, and heartwarming adventures. 

Currently we are still preparing rewards, setting up tiers, and refining details for the Kickstarter campaign of Teatopia. A follow on our campaign would be greatly appreciated! Thank you! <3
